Name: Kitchen sink
Description: A stainless kitchen sink and its mixer tap (RunningWaterSpec.KitchenSink, RunningWaterSynth). Off until somebody turns it on with the interact key standing at it: then the tap runs onto the steel and the bowl fills with the plug in; shut, the plug comes out and the bowl drains through its strainer, gurgling as it empties. Place it over the sink at rim height. Not a recording and not a loop.
